generation.scope: On any finite Frobenius graph, including nonreduced ones, a full square-root matrix cannot have generic rank two. Split rank two would place length twenty in a doubled fixed-eigenline scheme, whose maximum possible length is eighteen under the finite graph section bounds. Thus a root of finite submaximal locus is the unique distinct full opposite root on every such graph and is unramified when cubic evaluation is an isomorphism.
